full_judgment: 2. A complaint petition was filed directly before the Senior Special Judge, Satkhira with the allegation against the present petitioners along with the record keeper of the record room of Deputy Commissioner, Khulna committed forgery in the record for preparing khatian. The Special Judge after receiving the complaint sent the same before the Bureau of District Anti-Corruption for investigation and report and after perusing the report the Special Judge took cognizance only against the present petitioners under sections 420/467/ 468/471 of the Penal Code read with section 5(2) of Prevention of Corruption Act, 1947. Against the order of taking cognizance, the present petitioners moved this court by filing an application under section 56IA of the Code of Criminal Procedure for quashing the proceeding on the ground that since no cognizance was taken against any public servant, the Special Judge committed illegality in taking cognizance against the present petitioners who are private persons.
